sn35.109:1.1: Saṃyojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saṃyojanañ ca || taṃ suṇātha || || Katame ca bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā katamañ ca saṃyojanaṃ || || Cakkhum bhikkhave saṃyojaniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo || tam tattha saṃyojamaṃ || || la || Jivhā saṃyojaniyo dhammo || || Mano saṃyojaniyo dhammo || yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || Ime vuccanti bhikkhave saṃyojaniyā dhammā idaṃ saṃyojananti || ||
